approval.decision: Kris approved Creation B for #215: screen game-ui-theme-creation / create-config, revision create-config-v1. On 2026-11-23 he chose layout B over A and C ("4 - agree") and Ren'Py default as the theme selected first ("5 - default"). He asked for a council review of three rounds (Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.2 Sol scored 8 and 7.5, then 8.5 and 8.5, then 9 and 9); the round-three fixes were applied without a fourth review, as he chose. On 2026-11-25 he asked that this approval be recorded ("yes to 1 and 2"). The decision is recorded in issue #215.
behaviour: Step 3 of 4, Game configuration, of the production New Project wizard, drawn with its markup and styles: the resolution preset with Custom, the ratio preview, then a Look field with the seven theme title screens in a grid of four columns, Ren'Py default selected first.

Below the grid, the selected theme's dialogue box, its name and use, the fonts it copies into game/fonts/ with their license files, and a line that the look can change later on the Game-wide look page.
No step is added. The wizard panel scrolls, and keeps its scroll position when the author selects a different theme.
deviations: Production's .wizard-panel does not scroll at 1100 x 720; the mock adds align-self:stretch and min-height:0, which production needs when it builds this step.
The pictures are browser drawings of the stock title screen and dialogue box.
